span_definition: Maximum pair distance of XY-projected exterior mesh vertices; approximate geometric envelope, not foliage diameter or usable area.
angle_definition: Angle above horizontal of the chord joining the two endpoints of each ground-reaching centreline; not local tangent or unique inclination of the curved member.
source: Supplement D_BASE.3dm centre lines and D_BASE.npz exterior mesh; model-file calculation, not physical measurement.
